name: Clock & Google Calendar
author: ShadowOne
description: Omarchy's clock and calendar popup, plus read-only Google Calendar events from any number of Google accounts, with reminders.

barWidget.description: Date/time label with a calendar popup that shows your Google Calendar events.

schema.label: Sync every (minutes)
schema.description: How often events are fetched from Google. Opening the calendar also syncs when the data is over 2 minutes old.

schema.label: Remind before events (minutes)
schema.description: A notification this long before each timed event. 0 turns reminders off. Do Not Disturb still applies.

schema.label: Hide declined invitations
schema.description: Leave out events you said no to.

schema.label: Dots on days with events
schema.description: Small dots in the month grid, in each calendar's Google colour.
